# Job library (generated by `python tools/people_job.py --list`)

Job frame: the worker stands at the origin facing +Z, Y up, cm. `work point` = roughly where the hands work.
Fixture: bench = top 92 cm, front edge 25 cm ahead; panel = wall face at z 42 (58 for arm's-length jobs); free = no fixed bench.
